name: Half-Precision Rasterization with Cholesky Covariance and Local Coordinates
aliases: FP16 Rasterization with Cholesky and Local Coordinates
definition: A rendering pipeline operating entirely in half precision (fp16) to reduce memory footprint and increase load/store throughput, avoiding the arithmetic speedup which is negligible on commodity GPUs where packed half and single precision share math throughput.
summary: This method optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterization in half-precision by using Cholesky factors and local coordinates to prevent numerical instability and overflow.
